activity_summary: You gave Garnish fifty clean leaves before the king was played. He found the Wife, the Mother, and the Lady to be one woman, and you said one, the Lady. The fan-carrier is entered as Kemp, and the roll will be headed with his own name, because he would like it better. Heminges asked only for the count: twenty-odd parts, and three boys. Garnish made the two hours into three and called it a lie. You said a sonnet is allowed one. The rolls are not out. The company has not read the play. The fee was not this morning's line. You will not cross for the first Tamburlaine.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Handed the book, answered the faults, and refused a new tally.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Read standing, named the faults, and kept the fifty leaves.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Asked the count, and held the fee off today's line.

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: You have a Wife, a Mother, and a Lady in the margin, and I take them for one woman.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: It's a sonnet, Abel. They're allowed one.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: The fee on this book is not today's line.
